# Validation Test Case 2: Activity with Multiple Impulses

## Input
```json
{
  "templateId": "complex-feature-add",
  "variables": {
    "featureName": "multi-impulse-test",
    "requiresContext": true,
    "contextTypes": ["code-quality", "architecture", "patterns"]
  },
  "reason": "Test MCP data flow with multiple impulse types",
  "expectedImpulseCount": 5,
  "expectedComponentCount": 8
}
```

## Expected Output
```json
{
  "pass": true,
  "results": {
    "activityExecution": {
      "exists": true,
      "hasCorrectTemplate": true,
      "hasMetrics": true,
      "hasImpulsesUsed": true,
      "hasComponentChanges": true,
      "impulsesUsedCount": 5,
      "componentsChangedCount": 8
    },
    "impulseUsage": {
      "recordsCreated": true,
      "recordCount": 5,
      "linkedToExecution": true
    },
    "impulseRegistry": {
      "updatedSuccessRates": true,
      "impulseCount": 5
    },
    "mcpPayload": {
      "captured": true,
      "hasImpulsesUsed": true,
      "hasComponentChanges": true,
      "payloadSize": 4500
    }
  },
  "errors": []
}
```

## Test Description
Validates MCP data flow with complex activity that loads multiple impulses of different types.
Tests payload size handling and proper linkage of multiple impulses to single execution.

## Success Criteria
- All 5 impulses tracked correctly
- Each impulse linked to execution in impulse_usage table
- Success rates updated for all impulses in registry
- MCP payload correctly handles larger data volume (4-5KB)
- Component changes correctly extracted despite complex diff
